posts.name: Greywind
posts.cooked:
I am currently playing the video game. My team is comprised of Ra, Fanatic, Visionary, and The Wraith. The villain is Omnitron in Insula Primalis.

The situation is this: Visionary is the only hero left active, nestled inside a Telekinetic Cocoon with Demoralization and a Wrest the Mind in play. WtM is on an Enraged T-Rex. Figured that I would be able to redirect the T-Rex to munch on Omni or his parts as it is not a power card. It just happens.

But apparently it doesn't work if Visionary is in a Telekinetic Cocoon.

That doesn't seem right.
